text: {"sql":"SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN order_count >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS repurchase_rate FROM (SELECT o.customer_id, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count FROM orders o WHERE o.status = '已完成' AND o.created_at BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-07-31' GROUP BY o.customer_id)","unanswerable":false,"unanswerableReason":""}
